description: Get the full captured details (ElementInfo) of one event in a session by its event id, with the page errors captured around it (stack frames included) when there were any.

eventId.description: Event id within the session, e.g. "e3".

id.description: Session id (the folder name), "latest-here" (newest recording made on this project) or "latest" (newest of all).

repo.description: Absolute path of the project the recording was made on, to find its code locations in. Default: the project this server was started for.

name: get_element
